description: This Python source file defines the AnthropicFilesHandler class, which manages API interactions with Anthropic's message batch results. It includes methods for asynchronously fetching batch result content, transforming Anthropic responses into OpenAI-compatible formats, and handling batch result conversion and message transformation.
